summary: Ferrovial N.V. filed a Form 6-K on May 8, 2026, furnishing an investor presentation (Fact Book) as of December 2025. The presentation is a routine periodic update highlighting business model, total shareholder return, market cap, and equity value composition. It contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is an ordinary current report by a foreign private issuer, not triggering any special-situation category.
